author: tvami
body:
#### PR description:

`ConcurrentGeneratorFilter` only handles HepMC2: it calls `getGenEvent()` and never
`getGenEvent3()`. `Pythia8HepMC3ConcurrentGeneratorFilter` therefore compiles and runs
but returns false for every event, so the job silently writes an empty file. This ports
the `ivhepmc` dispatch already present in `GeneratorFilter`.

`ivhepmc` is read from a throw-away hadronizer instance in the constructor, because
`produces<>` must be declared there while the real hadronizer lives in the per-stream
cache. The hadronizer constructor only reads parameters (Pythia is initialised later in
`initializeForInternalPartons`).

HepMC3 together with `ExternalDecays` now throws a configuration error instead of failing
to compile: `ConcurrentExternalDecayDriver` has no HepMC3 `decay()` overload, unlike
`ExternalDecayDriver`. Use the non-concurrent `GeneratorFilter` for that combination.

Output changes only for the HepMC3 concurrent filters, which produced nothing before.

#### PR validation:

`cmsDriver.py ... -s GEN` with `Pythia8HepMC3ConcurrentGeneratorFilter` (DYToLL M-50,
4 threads): 5/5 events pass and the file contains `edm::HepMC3Product` at
`generator:unsmeared` plus `GenEventInfoProduct3`. The same config writes 0 events before
this PR. `Pythia8ConcurrentGeneratorFilter` (HepMC2) is unaffected.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not a backport.
title: Add HepMC3 support to ConcurrentGeneratorFilter
